richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kanpur

c: Kanpur has some of the largest campuses in Uttar Pradesh, from IIT Kanpur and the universities to the cantonment and old mill townships. Big campuses can hold a proper outdoor gym with a dozen stations. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to campuses, schools, housing societies, industrial colonies and parks in Kanpur, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,100 km away.

A large gym needs zones: strength for students, cardio for staff and gentle machines for families and visitors. We lay these out on a drawing so users do not crowd each other. Kanpur has very hot summers and cold, foggy winters, so the machines are galvanised and roto-moulded for year-round outdoor use. Fixing is by our installers or a north India dealer, using grouted or self-standing bases. Send us your campus plan to begin.

items.q: How do you plan a large outdoor gym on a campus?
items.a: We divide it into zones for strength, cardio and gentle exercise, and mark each station with its clear space on a layout drawing. Users then spread out instead of crowding one area.

items.q: Can the machines be used in Kanpur's winter fog?
items.a: Yes, though people often come later in the morning. Good lighting helps evening use. The galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats are made for outdoor use in all seasons.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms in Kanpur?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from our Vasai factory and install through our own team or a dealer in north India, as per the approved layout drawing.
